message.content:
A typical medium‑sized apple (about 182 g or roughly 3 inches across) contains around **95 kcal** (kilocalories).  
If you’re looking at a range:

| Size | Approximate weight | Calories |
|------|--------------------|----------|
| Small (≈149 g) | ~77 kcal |
| Medium (≈182 g) | ~95 kcal |
| Large (≈223 g) | ~116 kcal |

These numbers come from standard USDA data. The calorie count comes almost entirely from natural sugars (glucose, fructose, sucrose) and dietary fiber; there’s virtually no fat or protein. If you’re tracking macros, a medium apple gives you about 25 g of carbs (including ~4 g fiber) and less than 1 g of protein.
